content: Race condition: multiple state checks before mutation are not atomic even on the same event loop. Concurrent submit() calls or cancel_run() can interleave between these checks. Consider using asyncio.Lock or restructuring to make the check-then-set operation atomic.

Memory leak: items dict grows unbounded. ask() adds entries, submit() updates but never removes them, and forget() is only called when threads are deleted (not when individual runs complete). Every completed run leaks its PendingInput until thread deletion. Consider removing items in submit() after setting the result, or calling forget() in cancel_run().

        self.limit = limit
        self.timeout = timeout

Resource leak on timeout: when asyncio.timeout expires, item remains in self.items forever (unless forget() is eventually called). The TimeoutError propagates but the PendingInput is never removed. Consider adding self.items.pop((context.run_id, request_id), None) in the except block after marking cancelled.

async def ask(
        self, context: "InteractionContext", request: Mapping[str, Any]
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if context.run_id in self.closed:
            raise InteractionError("This run is no longer active.", 410)
        if not context.interactive:
            raise ModelCallExecutionError(
                "User input is required. Use the interactive chat endpoint."
            )
        if len(self.list_pending(context.run_id)) >= self.limit:
            raise ModelCallExecutionError("Too many pending input requests.")
        request_id = uuid4().hex
        data = {
            **request,
            "type": request.get("type") or "error",
            "request_id": request_id,
            "run_id": context.run_id,
            "thread_id": context.thread_id,
            "tool_call_id": context.tool_call_id,
            "source": context.source,
        }
        item = PendingInput(data, asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future())
        self.items[context.run_id, request_id] = item
        try:
            await self.publish(context.run_id, "input_required", data)
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.timeout):
                return await item.future
        except BaseException:
            item.cancelled = True
            item.future.cancel()
            raise
